commit 3f0e330dba1bcce4900316857bd2d3087e79f95b
Author: Sindre Sorhus <sindresorhus@gmail.com>
Date:   Sat Sep 26 08:30:36 2026 +0700

    Honour a late abort, count a no-op `content-encoding`, and keep wrapped headers immutable
    
    Count a no-op content-encoding and keep wrapped headers immutable
    
    A `content-length` header is valid for a response whose `content-encoding` is the registered no-op `identity`, so it is not discarded the way a real coding is.
    
    The `Response` constructor also rebuilds the header list under the mutable "response" guard, so a network response that arrived immutable would silently become mutable once wrapped. Reusing the original headers object keeps the guard.

Author: Sindre Sorhus <sindresorhus@gmail.com>
Date:   Mon Sep 21 01:02:49 2026 +0700

    Surface progress callback errors instead of a NetworkError
    
    A throwing `onUploadProgress` callback errors the request body stream. The runtime reports that stream failure as a generic network error, so Ky wrapped it in a `NetworkError` and the callback error was replaced by a misleading message. `isNetworkError()` then returned true for a user error, which also made the failure retriable.
